To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the magnetic composite sheets are promising for ITS application due to their low reflection coefficient at oblique incidence.
magnetic composites can be designed to absorb microwave at oblique incidence angles with a low value of the reflection loss.
magnetic composite sheets are designed for the reduction of electromagnetic wave reflection over wide incidence angles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the prediction of microwave absorption for magnetic composites at oblique incidence.
the design of single-layered magnetic microwave absorbing sheets for the achievement of a low reflection coefficient over a wide range of incidence angles.
the prediction of reflection loss for the three magnetic composites with different filler materials at oblique incidence angles for both TE and TM polarization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a magnetic composite sheet of iron particles with a matching thickness of 2 mm is the most suitable for the application of ITS frequency (5.99 GHz) for the achievement of wide angle microwave absorbing properties.

magnetic microwave absorbers with matching thickness of ~2 mm for the magnetic composite of iron particles are predicted for low reflection loss at wide incidence angles for the intelligent transport system (5.9 Ghz).
magnetic composite sheets of iron particles are suitable to be used as microwave absorbers at ITS frequency with wide incidence angles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
magnetic microwave absorbers with high performance are designed for oblique incidence angles for the achievement of ITS application.

the magnetic composite sheets with a matching thickness of ~2 mm are predicted for a wide range of incidence angles at ITS frequency (6 GHz) for the composite of iron particle with a high value of magnetic permeability and permittivity.
magnetic composites with high dielectric permittivities and magnetic permeabilities can be used as a single-layer absorber with wide incidence angles at 5.9-GHz ITS frequency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the magnetic composites can be designed for the achievement low reflection coefficient for both TE and TM polarization at wide incidence angles at ITS frequency.
the magnetic microwave absorber with iron particles can be applied to the ITS system with a high degree of flexibility.
the magnetic composite sheet of iron particles is the most effective for achieving the minimum value of reflection loss over wide incidence angles for the 5.9-GHz ITS frequency.
